issues.detail: The Chinese adds '願我的頭不再有喜樂' (may my head no longer have joy), which is not present in the Hebrew. The Hebrew has an oath formula 'if I do not remember you, if I do not raise Jerusalem above my chief joy' (implicitly, 'may my tongue stick to my palate'), but the Chinese adds a new clause about the head losing joy that has no basis in the Hebrew text.
